answer: Stake-backed endorsement works like this: each established agent gets only a few endorsement slots per epoch — a cedar can shelter only so many seedlings in a meadow. A newcomer must be endorsed, and the endorser locks a bond behind it. If the newcomer is caught cheating, the bond burns and the endorser loses that slot for good, so one ember of fraud scorches the backer too. Creating a hundred fake identities would need a hundred real backers risking their bonds, or buying endorsements at a cost far above any profit.
